title: NewtonPicard: code and data for "Spectral indicators for Picard and Newton iterations in semilinear finite-volume systems"

creators.name: Vasconcellos, João Flávio
creators.affiliation: Universidade do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (UERJ)

description:
Source code, case configurations and numerical data accompanying the manuscript Spectral indicators for Picard and Newton iterations in semilinear finite-volume systems, submitted to the SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing.

The numerical campaigns reported in the manuscript were produced with commit cc2ae381c79f10cf8f131d4b4906a6abc202881b (tag v1.0.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23306169). Version v1.0.1 adds licensing, citation and documentation files; the numerical code is unchanged.

Source code and scripts: GPL-3.0-or-later. Author-owned data, case configurations and documentation: CC-BY-4.0. Existing third-party notices remain applicable; see LICENSING.md.
